text:
deploy-bot: preflight check — canary failed for payments-service chart v2.4.1-canary

 deploy-bot: reason: potential plaintext credential detected at `values.payments.stripe.api_key` (masked) in canary override bundle. blocking promotion :warning:

 alex: ugh, is this from chart default values or the tenant override we applied earlier?

 maria: looks like a values override from the staging PR that merged this morning. short diff shows `stripe.api_key: "sk_live_***"` — should've been a k8s secret ref.

 jordan: can we hotpatch the override to use `secretKeyRef` and re-run canary, or do we need to rollback to v2.4.0?

 sre-oncall: leaning rollback. can't risk leaking keys in values.yaml even if masked. we should pin the release and do a silent rollback for now.

 release-captain: agree. plan: 1) manual rollback to chart v2.4.0 2) pin chart in release control to prevent auto-promotion 3) draft a short release-note blurb about reverting canary 4) create follow-up PR to fix overrides and re-promote in next window.

 alex: commands ready:
```
# rollback helm release
helm upgrade payments-service redwood/payments --reuse-values --version 2.4.0 -n prod
# OR use rollback
helm rollback payments-service 3 -n prod
kubectl annotate deploy payments-service redwood/release-action="rollback-2923456789" -n prod
```

 maria: i can push the values-fix PR and add tests to lint for plain secrets. will add a pre-merge check to block key-like strings.

 jordan: can someone pin the chart in deploy control so the deploy-bot doesn't re-run the canary with the same bundle?

 release-captain: @deploy-bot please hold any promotions for payments-service until manual override cleared. also add slack blurb for the on-call channel.

 deploy-bot: acknowledged — promotions paused for payments-service; creating rollback run and pin entry. logging incident id: ir-2026-03-canary-17 :lock:

 sre-oncall: after rollback, audit who merged the override and run a quick secret-scan across other charts. tag me if you need help.

 release-captain: will draft release note: "Reverted canary of payments-service (v2.4.1-canary) due to config override accidentally containing plaintext credential. A fix is in progress; re-deploy planned after audit." short, factual.

 maria: noted, pushing PR now. i'll link pr and fix ticket in the rollback thread.

 alex: thanks all. logging action items in the deploy checklist.
